text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in Macedonian papers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The Macedonian government discussed Gostivar events on Wednesday. Ethnic Albanian ministers demanded revised report on police exceeding its authority threatening to leave the parliament if it was not satisfactory.

- The republic's parliament will debate Tetovo and Gostivar events and police behaviour on Thursday. The ethnic Albanian party PDPA said would ask for resignation of Minister of Interior Tomislav Cokrevski.
- The European Union supports the Macedonian government efforts to ease tensions in mostly ethnic Albanian Gostivar and Tetovo and demands firm control of the police actions.
- Macedonian Defence Minister Lazar Kitanovski is expected to meet his Bulgarian counterpart Giorgi Ananiev in Skopje either on July 25 or 31.
- Special U.N. human rights raporteur Elisabeth Rehn is expected to visit Macedonia in August. Her visit is probably linked to Gostivar events, paper said.
- Tetovo ethnic Albanian mayor Alajdin Demiri and city council president Bebi Bedzeti to face criminal charges.
- A fire, raging since Monday in the region of Macedonian southern town of Gevgelija, was put out by Macedonian army helicopters. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
